queries: OpenAI adds Google cloud to meet growing compute capacity needs Reuters June 2025
OpenAI selects Oracle Cloud Infrastructure to extend Microsoft Azure AI platform June 2024

sources_considered.why: Reuters exclusive on OpenAI adding Google Cloud capacity, deal finalized May 2025.
Reuters follow-up: OpenAI's own supplier list names Google, Oracle and CoreWeave alongside Microsoft.
Shows Oracle capacity already in use before the post, though as an extension of Azure. Context only.

receipt.public_excerpt: Google's cloud unit, which will supply additional computing capacity to OpenAI's existing infrastructure for training and running its AI models

evidence_items.explanation: Google Cloud, an existing provider outside Microsoft, agreed in May 2025 to supply OpenAI with additional compute. The same article says the deal had been under discussion for months, so this option existed when the post was written.

receipt.public_excerpt: Google already lacked sufficient capacity to meet its cloud customers' demands as of the last quarter

evidence_items.explanation: This partly backs the spirit of Zitron's point. Even the alternative providers were capacity-constrained, so how much Google could add is unclear.

receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI has included Alphabet’s (GOOGL.O) Google Cloud among its suppliers to meet escalating demands for computing capacity

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI's own supplier list later confirmed Google Cloud, along with Oracle and CoreWeave, as compute suppliers. It falls just after the target period, so it is context.

receipt.public_excerpt: partnering to extend the Microsoft Azure Al platform to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) to provide additional capacity for OpenAl.

evidence_items.explanation: Oracle's existing infrastructure already supplied OpenAI before the post, but through Microsoft's Azure arrangement. It is ambiguous whether that counts as 'outside of Microsoft', so it is context only.

unresolved_gaps: The size of Google's capacity for OpenAI was not disclosed. Whether it could meet OpenAI's full expansion needs is not known.
No public data shows how much existing non-Microsoft capacity OpenAI used in Q2 2025.
